thread:
paul: heads up 60 — loading a per-route view with model filters expanded spikes cold-load p95 to ~2s. looks like we're doing route summary + N model stats calls and blocking render.

anya: confirmed. desktop/mobile both. client waits for all model calls before showing main chart which is bad.

srinivas: backend thought: add an aggregate endpoint /api/console/route_view/combined that returns route summary and model slices in one payload. can include cache-control and sample info.

zoe: product question: should combined be the default for saved queries? concern: pulls increase telemetry usage which may hit org quotas. we should surface that clearly.

paul: UX compromise: saved-query gets a small flag include_model_telemetry: off|on|auto. auto = server decides based on org quota + recent usage. show a badge when detailed telemetry is active.

anya: API sketch: GET /api/console/views/{id}?expand=combined&model_sample=0.2&cache_ttl=30 -> response returns data + meta:prefetch_applied,sample_rate,quota_status (client reads meta to show a toast if downgraded).

srinivas: also add X-Prefetch-Downgraded header when we returned less than requested. and emit meter tag console.view.telemetry(view_id,org_id). ops wants an event on downgrade.

billing-bot: please ensure billing tags are included and that cache hits still trigger a lightweight meter ping so we can account usage. otherwise we'll underbill cached views.

zoe: UX microcopy draft: "Include per-model telemetry (may increase telemetry usage)." Tooltip: "We may sample or fall back to route-level metrics if your org quota is constrained." Inline hint: "Estimated extra telemetry: ~+0.5s first load" (we'll replace with measured numbers).

paul: rollout plan: behind FF. 1) implement combined endpoint, 2) add saved-view flag persisted on the view, 3) client surface meta + downgrades, 4) meter events + billing tags, 5) session cache heuristic for repeated opens.

anya: session cache idea: cache combined payload per session (org+user+view) for X minutes and serve stale-while-revalidate. reduces repeated telemetry cost for quick back-and-forth. but billing-bot insists we still emit meter events on cache hits.

srinivas: cheap server-side optimization: when prefetch requested, aggregate model stats in single DB query / streaming join. should keep backend CPU reasonable. I'll prototype and measure.

billing-bot: ack. will add billing hooks and doc the meter contract. include downgrade events and cache-hit pings.

zoe: owners: srinivas backend PR, anya client + saved-view schema, paul umbrella ticket + rollout plan, me (zoe) will push microcopy and figma mock.

console-bot: perf summary: staging run with combined endpoint -> median load 360ms (was ~1.9s), p95 920ms (was ~3.1s). run id: combined-prefetch-2026-03-22.

paul: great. let's keep default off for free orgs and enable auto for larger orgs in beta. will file acceptance criteria and assign follow-ups. thanks team. :tada:

end of thread
